items.title: Jason Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Now that caught my attention, because I knew who Tony Williams was.

ctx.x: You were living the jazz life as a kid.

Oh yeah. I was all about it. That’s the frightening thing. I was all about playing and staying up. I didn’t care. But, during this same trip, all of a sudden Delfeayo tells me, “Yeah, man, you’re going to have some drum lessons with Alan Dawson.” “Okay. Who’s that? All right.” “Yeah, yeah. He taught Tony Williams a long time ago.” “Oh really?” Now that caught my attention, because I knew who Tony Williams was.
How did you come about knowing about Tony Williams or any other drummers? Who were the other drummers you knew about at this time?
